title: Multiparametric Assessment of the Right Ventricle, Including 3D Echocardiography, as a Prognostic Marker in Heart Failure
official: Multiparametric Assessment of the Right Ventricle, Including 3D Echocardiography, as a Prognostic Marker in Heart Failure
summary: This is a prospective, single-center study conducted within the cardiology department of Clermont-Ferrand University Hospital (CHU), enrolling patients hospitalized for acute cardiac decompensation requiring intravenous diuretic therapy. Assessment of right ventricular function by echocardiography was performed at admission and again at the switch to oral diuretics. Telephone follow-up was scheduled at 3 months and 12 months after hospital discharge
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* being of legal age
* being capable of providing consent to the study
* being affiliated with a social security/health insurance scheme

Exclusion Criteria:

* life expectancy of less than 1 year
* adult patients under legal protection measures (guardianship, conservatorship, or emergency judicial protection)
* inability to provide consent
* cardiogenic shock
* acute-phase myocardial infarction
* cardiac tamponade, aortic dissection
* pulmonary embolism
* heart transplantation
* known pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
* right ventricular disease such as arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia (ARVD).
* Patients also had to have sufficient echogenicity to allow satisfactory imaging of the right ventricle
